description.content: Fetch the trimmed source-video transcript for a project. ASR internals (seek, tokens, log-probabilities, etc.) are stripped. For API callers on a range-limited project, paragraphs are filtered to the billed curation range; internal callers and full-source submissions get the full transcript.

query.description: (Required) Query variant. Public callers must pass `findByProjectId`.

description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: bearer
